text: Weeks after the killing of journalist Jamal Khashoggi at the Saudi consulate in Istanbul, WWE decided to uphold its contractual obligations to the Saudi General Sports Authority and stage its November 2018 Riyadh event (Crown Jewel).
short: WWE staged Crown Jewel 2018 in Riyadh weeks after the Khashoggi killing

source.name: WWE Q3 2018 earnings release
source.quote: Considering the heinous crime committed at the Saudi consulate in Istanbul the Company faced a very difficult decision as it relates to its event scheduled for November 2 in Riyadh.
